title: The kandil stays up all month (Diwali)
caption:
The kandil stays up all month. So can this.

In a lot of homes the akash kandil stays up till Tulsi Vivah. The Prism Rivière carries its colours: aqua, pink and pale yellow cushion stones, each in a halo, adjustable from 15 to 19 cm. ₹2,399.

Shubh Deepavali from all of us at Naira.

[ prism rivière bracelet · rhodium plated · matched to the kandil ]
alt_text: A deep bottle-green night tile. A glowing paper star lantern, an akash kandil, in aqua, pink and pale yellow hangs from a thin gold-coloured string, three pinked paper tails trailing down toward a rhodium-plated tennis bracelet of aqua, pink and pale yellow cushion stones, each in a halo. Small type at the top reads The Match, N° 06, Diwali. Below it on the left, beside the lantern, Shubh Deepavali in gold Devanagari script. Cream capitals read: The kandil stays up all month. Below, in blush italics: so can this. A thin thread ties the bracelet to an ivory tag striped aqua, pink and yellow, reading Shade N° 06, matched to the kandil, aqua, pink, pale yellow. The footer reads Prism Rivière Bracelet, rhodium plated.
deviations: Kandil axis moved from x540 to x650 (star centre (650,300), string (650,0) to (650,160), glow and core centred on it). At x540 the string ran straight through the eyebrow: the specced eyebrow (Tiro 40 + 16px gap + Jost 20 .30em) measures x72-586 and the string cut between 'N°' and '06'. At x650 the string clears the eyebrow's last glyph by about 70px; the star spans x517-783, well clear of the top-right icon corner.

Bracelet centre moved from (540,790) to (600,774): x+60 so it still hangs under the kandil and the tails trail down onto it; y-16 (fix pass) so the piece spans y640-908 and clears the cap line of THE KANDIL (y967) by 59px instead of 43, with the pale glow pool (centred 6px under the lowest pixel) off the cap line. Width 460 unchanged. Thread anchor (812,778): on the last link's metal at the right end (alpha 255 across a 9x9 window), about 12px inside the matte's rightmost point (824,767), so the 2px gold visibly crosses a link (tied) rather than meeting the outline (spec 'about (765,790)' was the bracelet's right edge before the move).

Tails: hung 13px inside each lower tip and clipped to that point's lower edge, so they read as tucked behind the paper (hung straight from the tips, their tops showed as small rectangles beside the points); the centre tail hangs from behind the bottom notch. The spec's lengths (180/220/200) and 'ending near y640' cannot both hold from tips at y413 and a notch at y362; ends set at y600 / 608 / 620 (visible lengths about 189 / 246 / 207), staggered, each tip clearing the bracelet's top edge by 39.5 / 40 / 42.5px measured across the strip's full width, so the gap reads as deliberate rather than a near-miss. Pinked edges: tooth 10, depth 3, the right edge half a tooth out of phase with the left (in phase, the strips read as strings of beads). S-sway amplitude 5-6px.
Lamp core (d70 #FFF7E0 70%, blur 18) drawn over the ivory centre pentagon, not behind the star: behind an opaque star it would be invisible. It reads as the lamp seen through the paper.

Kandil glow: same centre (650,300), but r300 -> 240 with stops #FFF7E0 42% at 0, #F6E3A1 18% at .30, 4% at .65, 0 at 1 (spec: #F6E3A1 38% to 0 over r300). The spec's pale gold at 38% over bottle green mixed to about rgb(122,127,96) and read as an olive-khaki haze across the upper field; tightened and warmed, the light gathers at the star like a lamp through paper (field left of the star, x400-500 y150-450, now rgb 53,72,61 against plain ground 50,70,60). Falls off through intermediate stops so there is no visible disc edge.

Glow under the bracelet: the spec's #F6E3A1 12%, 380x60, blur 40 could not be seen at all on bottle green; now 24%, 420x60, blur 30, centred 6px under the bracelet's lowest pixel (system default). It reads as a faint pool of the kandil's light, still no dark contact shadow.

Eyebrow (grid-director SF3, 26 Oct; supersedes the mixed Tiro + Jost line): the top rail is Jost only, one a-eyebrow a-series line 'THE MATCH · N° 06 · DIWALI' at x72 b112, the pattern of P2, P4, P10 and P11. It was the one rail that led with a 40px Tiro word and dropped the occasion. शुभ दीपावली is now the tile's one Devanagari line, on its own: a-script, Tiro Devanagari Marathi 48px, date gold #E7C27A, x72 b330, in the empty upper left beside the kandil. Ink x71-303, y288-342: ~107px clear of the glow's edge at that height (x410) and 347px of the string (x650); the ground beside it is unlifted (49,69,58 at x400 as at x100).

Caption (post.json and briefs/option-a.json, fix pass): body 'stays lit through Kartik' -> 'stays up till Tulsi Vivah' and bracket 'lit till Tulsi Vivah' -> 'matched to the kandil', so the caption gives the kandil one end point (Kartik ends about 24 Nov in the North and about 9 Dec in the amanta calendar; Tulsi Vivah is Sat 21 Nov) and the bracket echoes the tag as P1's 'matched to the red' does. The brief's open question for the owner (open_questions_for_owner[3]) quoted the old line verbatim; it now quotes the new one, so the owner is asked about the line that will run.

Grid-director pass (26 Oct): no layout change (skeleton B). Re-rendered after system fix 1 only: the tag's three-band chip is now three 208x16 bands at y16 / 32 / 48 inside the inset window, so the N° 06 tag has the same silhouette as the other eight.

ECD pass (26 Oct), SF1: the footer 'PRISM RIVIÈRE BRACELET · [ RHODIUM PLATED ]' is the a-foot component at b1352 (was a-label 18px). At 20px it ran to x758, past the tag's x740 line, so it carries data-fit="664": 19.35px, ending at x736 (measured in Chromium). Nothing else changed; alt text and caption unchanged.
checks: Price ₹2,399 = research/roster.json today (25 Oct 2026); stock 67, tags Rhodium Plated, Cubic Zirconia. Price in the caption only; no price, code, percentage or date on the image. Caption gives the kandil one end point (Tulsi Vivah), which leads into P11, the Tulsi Vivah post.

Claims: 'RHODIUM PLATED' = Shopify tag 'Rhodium Plated'; no gold wording anywhere (rhodium-only piece, no 'made to stay gold.'), no 'silver', no 'diamond', no water/tarnish claims. Caption facts match the listing: aqua, pink, pale yellow cushion-cut cubic zirconia, each in a pavé halo, adjustable 15-19 cm. RIVIÈRE set only in Jost (È renders), never in Velista.

Copy: no em dashes, exclamation marks, emoji or urgency on the image or in the caption; the cultural line stays softened ('In a lot of homes'), pending the owner's open question. Alt text written to the render and uses 'rhodium-plated' and 'gold-coloured string' rather than metal claims.

Devanagari: शुभ दीपावली rendered in Tiro Devanagari Marathi and checked at 2x (श+ु, भ, दी, पा, व, ली all shape correctly); it is the tile's one script line. Still needs the named Marathi reader's sign-off.

Cut-out: prism-riviere-bracelet/x00-trim.png (not 00, which kept the velvet), native 966x588, shown 460x280 (48%), never above native, unrotated, not recoloured. Matte checked at 100% on lac #42060E and on bottle green: clean alpha, no plaster or velvet halo; the soft far side is the photo's own depth of field.

Safe areas: content y~98 (eyebrow cap top, b112) to 1382 (tag corner), inside y45-1395; the string runs off the top edge by design. Top-right x>=907, y<=202 is plain ground (pixel std 0.8-1.2, mean = plain ground). Headline lines end at x565 / 475 / 572, footer at x690, all inside x72-740. Corner x>=740 & y>=1010: the only non-ground pixels outside the tag are the thread's own run into the hole (x855-863, y1010-1027). Tag in the fixed cover position (rotated box x753-1027, y1028-1382), hole (904,1073), thread M904 1073 Q858 1103 812 778 (system control point), z-order ground < kandil < cut-out < thread < tag < grain. Bracelet y639.5-908, headline cap top y967: 59px of air.

Type: baselines eyebrow b112 (a-series, since 26 Oct; was 117.8 for b118), Devanagari b330, headline 1029.4 / 1117.4 / 1205.4 (1030 / 1118 / 1206), turn 1281.1 (1282), footer 1351.7 (1352). Velista 88 with ligatures off (STAYS, ALL plain); all fonts loaded, no missing images; no widows, clipped glyphs or overlaps. Tag: SHADE N° 06 / MATCHED TO / THE / KANDIL (Velista 36, name widths 67 / 122) / 'aqua, pink, pale yellow' on one line (162px).

Contrast measured against rendered pixels (ground with grain = rgb 50,70,60): headline cream 8.1 against the brightest ground just above its cap line (8.9 on plain ground), turn blush-mid 7.0, Devanagari date gold 6.0, eyebrow kicker 6.76 against the brightest ground patch around it (was 5.85 by the same method before the glow was tightened), footer kicker 7.3; tag labels warm grey on paper 5.4.

Kandil: flat paper-cut five-point star, R140 r62, first point up, each point split on its centre line into light/dark facets (aqua, pink, pale yellow, aqua, pink clockwise from the top), ivory centre pentagon, 2px ivory 60% on every facet edge drawn once (no doubled strokes), no extruded side band; checked at 2x for seams.

Thumb (391x521): THE KANDIL / STAYS UP / ALL MONTH. reads, and the bracelet now sits clearly apart from the headline; the lantern, bracelet and striped tag read. Grid check re-run after the fix pass (_work/gridcheck.png, rows r2-r4 with P1-P5, P7 cover, P8, P9): the tag lands in the same corner and angle as its neighbours and the bottle green sits as row 3's dark tile between ivory P3 below and apricot P9 above.
4:5 crop (s01-45.jpg, y45-1395) keeps every element; tag 13px from its bottom edge.

Fix pass re-render: build.py -> s01.html, render.cjs (no missing images, all fonts loaded), export.py; baselines unchanged (117.8 / 1029.4 / 1117.4 / 1205.4 / 1281.1 / 1351.7). Generated comments updated (cut-out centre (600,774), thread anchor on the last link) so they match the file.

Grid-director pass (26 Oct): s01 re-rendered (render.cjs + export.py); the only change against the previous render is inside the tag's chip area (x781-1026, y1028-1116). Viewed at full size and as the thumb. render.cjs: missingImages [], fontsNotLoaded [].

Grid-remaining pass (26 Oct): _work/build.py edited (rail, Devanagari line, and the a-foot footer that s01.html carried by hand since the ECD pass, so build.py and the page agree again) and re-run; s01 re-rendered and viewed at full size and as the thumb (शुभ दीपावली reads at 391px, the rail matches the other covers). render.cjs missingImages [], fontsNotLoaded []. check.cjs: 265px of thread outside the tag; KICKER rhodium once (footer). SF1 maker's mark (system, 26 Oct): every non-mini tag now carries the flower as a crisp 18x26 blush mark at (111,286) in the tag's lower third, 8px above the inner gold rule, instead of the 62x90 ghost at 12% behind the second name line and the detail (read as a pink smudge at 100%).
